name: monty
description: A secure Python sandbox, written in Rust, for code written by AI.

issues.title: Discussion: Support for inheritance in user code
MontyRepl time limit (max_duration_secs) is measured from REPL construction, not per feed_run
Proposal: treat Python type annotations as runtime contracts

latest_release.name: v1.6.0 - 2026-11-11
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Wait for departed remote streams on pool close by @strawgate in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1257
* Add exclusive file creation to the filesystem protocol by @tomhoule in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1245
* Require Rust 1.98 so macOS 27 builds load by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1259
* Convert heap reads to PyValue before protocol dispatch by @jaheba in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1242
* Add a `browser_cdp` example by @samuelcolvin in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1244
* Preserve remote error details and expose typed client failures by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1260
* Encode dumped location tables as compact byte strings by @samuelcolvin in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1258
* Point argument-count errors at the call, not the def by @samuelcolvin in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1184
* Reuse immutable inputs in builtin constructors by @jaheba in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1266
* Release namedtuple clones on memory limit errors by @jaheba in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1267
* Rename Full Monty to Commercial Support in docs by @laisbsc in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1294
* Send the first request behind `Configure` without waiting for its reply by @samuelcolvin in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1250
* Add numeric fast paths for binary arithmetic by @jaheba in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1090
* Make nested-function scope analysis linear in nesting depth by @r3v2d0g in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1288
* Skip formatting BigInts too large for the telemetry cap by @r3v2d0g in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1289
* Check JSONDecodeError doc length before copying it by @r3v2d0g in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1290
* Rename the protocol roles from parent/child to client/worker by @samuelcolvin in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1300
* Start list and tuple index searches at the requested offset by @jaheba in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1270
* Start async host calls without waiting for the host by @rewitt94 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1226
* Return at once when repeating an empty list or deque by @greenhat in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1282
* Match CPython's pathlib errors by @rewitt94 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1213
* Bump yanked clipboard-win to 5.4.3 by @Viicos in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1303
* Bump version to v1.6.0 by @samuelcolvin in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1304

## New Contributors
* @tomhoule made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1245
* @laisbsc made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1294
* @r3v2d0g made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1288
* @greenhat made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1282

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/monty/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0
